heading: *Oak Grove Panthers - Loretta
narrative: - In the beginning, I made a mistake. I invited my wife at the time to be in this league. At the time it seemed ok but it went downhill fast. She has been playing FF since 1997. She won our 1st Super Bowl and won her division once. Might have been the last time she won anything. I had been accused of running her team but that wasn't the case until the last season she played in the league, so I dropped her. She played 4 seasons with us until 2009. Then I got rid of her altogether. She was 2-0 in the Playoffs by getting to the postseason her 1st and only year. She got less wins every year. She was 38-38 during the regular season. Loretta had a Defensive Rookie of the Year (Clay Matthews). She is in the record books with a win in the closest game by beating Creston by .05 points. In 2010 she was gone for good, fantasy league and my life. She still lives in Florida, a trailer park, last I heard. Probably with 15 cats.
